Definition: from a compound of G3173 and αὐχέω (to boast; akin to G837 and G2744); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic):--boast great things.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to talk big, to boast, and it is used once, of the tongue: it is a little member, and it boasteth great things, as a small fire kindles a great forest.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the little member is the most dangerous part of the body: it boasts great things, and the forest it kindles is a life, a church, or a family.
